lines.text: That glass of wine? It isn't calming you down. I know — I didn't want to hear it either. But stay with me, because this explains a lot.
Here's what's actually happening. Wine quiets your brain for about two hours. Then, while you sleep, it bounces back the other way — harder.
That's why you're wide awake at 3am, heart pounding about nothing. The nightly glass that takes the edge off is the thing sharpening it.
And I'm not going to tell you to just quit and white-knuckle your evenings. I tried that. It didn't work.
What worked was keeping my ritual — and changing what's in it. Another mom put me onto these microdose gummies.
One gummy in the evening instead of the pour. The calm shows up — but it doesn't bounce back on you. And there's a lab report in every pouch, so I knew exactly what I was taking.
That first week, I slept through the night for the first time in months. By week three, the edge just… wasn't there to take off anymore.
So keep the ritual. The couch. The exhale. The end of the day, marked. Just change what's in the glass. 60-day guarantee — full refund, no hoops. Link below.
